data.long_meaning: The name Jasrel is derived from the Hebrew language. It is composed of two parts: ‘Yasher’, which means ‘to be right, to be straight’, and ‘El’, meaning ‘God’. Thus, the name Jasrel translates to ‘God heals’. The name Jasrel carries the meaning “God heals” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Jasrel usually hope their child will grow to embody god heals and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jasrel is a name of trust and hope. It symbolizes God's healing power and the belief that He is always present to help and restore.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jasrel total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
